evidence.quote: IFNγ ELISpot assays were performed on freshly isolated PBMC from all 24 subjects at screening and at 1, 2, 4, 12 and 24 weeks post-vaccination, using the Human IFNγ ELISpot (ALP) kit (Mabtech).
Frozen PBMC were thawed and rested overnight in R10 with 10 U/ml Benzonaze (Merck Chemicals).

name_in_paper: surface staining PBMC for 30 min at 37 °C with CCR4/PERCPCY5.5, CCR6/AF647 (Biolegend), CCR7/PECY7 and CXCR3/PECY5 (BD Bioscience)

evidence.quote: To assess the effect of vaccination route on cell trafficking we measured the expression of chemokine receptors by surface staining PBMC for 30 min at 37 °C with CCR4/PERCPCY5.5, CCR6/AF647 (Biolegend), CCR7/PECY7 and CXCR3/PECY5 (BD Bioscience)
Anti-r85A IgG was measured in serum samples collected at week 0, 2, 4 and 24.

name_in_paper: negative ex vivo ELISpot response to ESAT-6 and CFP-10 peptides

evidence.quote: Latent infection with M. tb was excluded by means of a negative ex vivo ELISpot response to ESAT-6 and CFP-10 peptides.

name_in_paper: serological testing for hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV

evidence.quote: Enrolled subjects were in good health, had normal baseline haematology and biochemistry, and negative serological testing for hepatitis B, hepatitis C and HIV.

name_in_paper: Routine laboratory biochemical and haematological parameters

evidence.quote: Routine laboratory biochemical and haematological parameters were measured at 7 and 84 days post-vaccination.
